audit_question: Does a component actually change the output?
conventional_check: structural reading: the component exists and its feature specification is non-empty
blind_dimension: activity of the input: existing is not the same as varying
instance_in_this_work: a branch declares zero features and still occupies a slot; a declared feature resolves to a zero fill
prescription: run a finite difference with respect to the branch input per component; never substitute "the component is present"

audit_question: Does a component actually change the output?
conventional_check: finite differences under a per-branch perturbation
blind_dimension: the evaluation path: the perturbation must propagate through the arguments the evaluation actually passes, and must reach a channel the fitted component splits on
instance_in_this_work: no call site passes the audio input; eight of the nine keys fill from an empty vector, and the fitted component splits on the ninth alone
prescription: apply the perturbation at the evaluation entry point, then read the fitted component's split columns: a perturbation that cannot reach a live split cannot change the output

audit_question: Does the boundary characterise the threat or the audited object?
conventional_check: reproduce across configurations and see whether the boundary moves
blind_dimension: single-variable: two factors moved at once cannot be attributed
instance_in_this_work: a 2x2 over model and calibration prior; one pair changes only the prior
prescription: flip one factor at a time and report the quantities held fixed (here: the fixed-threshold reading is identical to the digit)

audit_question: Does the boundary characterise the threat or the audited object?
conventional_check: order perturbation: replay under different arrival orders
blind_dimension: composition of the denominator: a pooled rate is not comparable across different segment mixes
instance_in_this_work: a framed share of 69.6% against 48.6% inflates a pooled ratio
prescription: normalise within segment for any cross-pool comparison, and report the composition and the dropped counts alongside

audit_question: Do the counts correspond to distinct content?
conventional_check: threshold-style completeness: whether the count meets its target
blind_dimension: content and de-duplication: meeting the row target is not the same as distinct texts
instance_in_this_work: 300 rows are 30 texts repeated ten times, so held-out text overlap is 28/28
prescription: everywhere a set is declared, report the row count and the distinct-content count as two separate numbers

conventional_check: reconciliation of declared against evaluated counts
blind_dimension: trace of the discarding action: a silent continue leaves no trace
prescription: every silent discard path (continue, except: return, an if guard on a field) must leave a trace with a reason and a count

audit_question: Has a known fact taken effect?
conventional_check: recording: whether the structural fact was written into an artifact or a comment
blind_dimension: propagation into the invariant: recorded is not the same as used to constrain the design
instance_in_this_work: a tenfold repetition structure was recorded twice and never reached the held-out construction
prescription: a recorded fact must be bound to the invariant it constrains; a note in the margin is not in effect
